defects.description: Concurrent multi-window access to the same workspace root triggers startup stale-directory cleanup; DocuReady supports single-instance workspace isolation only.
defects.root_cause: Single-user desktop temp workspace design without distributed file locking.
defects.remediation: Documented as explicit unsupported concurrent operation; single-session isolation enforced.

defects.description: Direct callers passing ExtractedField with unparsed string normalized_value for numeric fields raise TypeError on ceiling comparison; AuditPipeline/DocumentExtractor always normalizes before validation.
defects.remediation: Preserved internal contract; verified AuditPipeline normalizes all extracted fields.

defects.description: Under Windows Tesseract 5.4.0, profile_document() took 1020.83–1129.65 ms on DOC_CTRL_01 (test target <850 ms) and 1582.11–1602.15 ms on DOC_EXT_07 (test target <1400 ms).
defects.root_cause: Subprocess Tesseract cold invocation overhead in adaptive profiling exceeds tight historical Loop 17/18 wall-clock thresholds on current host load.
defects.remediation: Recorded honestly without relaxing historical test assertions; functional accuracy and abstention unaffected.
